original_value: We propose endurance sports as a rich and novel domain for recommender systems and machine learning research. As sports like marathon running, triathlons, and mountain biking become more and more popular among recreational athletes, there exists a growing opportunity to develop solutions to a number of interesting prediction, classification, and recommendation challenges, to better support the complex training and competition needs of athletes. Such solutions have the potential to improve the health and well-being of large populations of users, by promoting and optimising exercise as part of a productive and healthy lifestyle.

result.paraphrase: We suggest endurance sports as a valuable and emerging area for recommender systems and machine learning research. As recreational athletes increasingly take up sports such as marathon running, triathlons, and mountain biking, there is a expanding opportunity to create solutions for a range of interesting prediction, classification, and recommendation problems, in order to better meet athletes’ complex training and competition needs. These solutions could improve the health and well-being of large populations of users by encouraging and optimizing exercise as part of a productive, healthy lifestyle.
